{{Quote|I met this Neimoidian in a drinkin' hole on Tatooine. Claimed t'be related to Medd Valii. I looked up this Valii. Seems he was pretty big back in the day. Made money. Lotsa money.|Adah Meborman|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
At some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="date">According to [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occur in the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], we can conclude that the Neimoidian was alive sometime between then.</ref> a '''Neimoidian''' spoke with [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Adah Meborman]] in a drinking hole on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] claimed to be related to [[Medd Valii]], who had accrued a large amount of money during his lifetime. In addition, the Neimoidian told the smuggler that Valii's money had been hidden in the form of pure [[Gold/Legends|gold]] in the arch of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. The Neimoidian was later mentioned in a security [[Hologram/Legends|holo log]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] investigation of Meborman.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neimoidian was first mentioned in the "Tarko-se" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
